identity.scenario: Chromium SwiftShader; 1280x800; light UI; 2026-11-06 clock; 1 fresh browser per revision; same runner
identity.cachePolicy: separate fresh browser instances; browser default cache; same-page date-return reuse
identity.memoryPolicy: V8 main page used heap via CDP after GC; Chromium process-family PSS via Linux procfs when available (includes workers/WASM in process memory, excludes GPU VRAM).
identity.cpuPolicy: CDP TaskDuration and ScriptDuration are renderer task/script time (not system-wide CPU percent).
identity.framePolicy: requestAnimationFrame pacing is a scheduling FPS proxy, not measured GPU presentation rate.
identity.gpuPolicy: GPU draw-call and buffer counts from renderer; actual VRAM/utilization/kernel timing not measured.

clockPolicy: Date offset starts at 2026-11-06; native timers and elapsed time continue normally.
limitations: Only a bounded LOD5 region uses Q1; lower LODs use the original v0.14 tiles.
A0 is a separate existing-data baseline and does not use Q1, the experiment shader or a modified admission budget.
A1/B/C/D use an experiment-only 192MiB visible DEM admission limit; A0 retains the product default of 96MiB and may select a coarser level.
Programmatic camera setup triggers the full view invalidation in this experiment so label layout follows the camera.
Only WebGL2 at desktop DPR 1 on SwiftShader; smoke mode covers one stationary 32x scene only.
Warm return is same-page memory/cache reuse, not a separate browser warm-navigation measurement.
512 versus 1024 varies tile partition only; an atlas or instancing optimization is not implemented.
Playwright interception proxies fixed-commit bytes; CDP network totals are partial and not real-host transfer measurements.
COG runs use a simulated same-origin 206 range host; GitHub raw CORS is not fixed by this test.
Screen-space D is a bounded 512-tile atlas prototype; unsupported coverage retains the existing tile path and is not counted as D.
rAF intervals are scheduling proxies, not actual GPU presentation or GPU time.
